replays.title: Three largest Q3 declines, cited
replays.description: An analyst's run: sales declines from the sales tool, policy passages from document search, a cited summary. A non-allowlisted tool, a smuggled tenant id and a citation of a restricted document are all denied.

replays.title: A viewer asks for sales data
replays.description: The viewer role lacks sales:read, so the gateway denies the sales tool; with no supported finding left, the run abstains.

replays.title: Quarters with no data
replays.description: The requested quarters precede the dataset, so the run abstains (NO_SALES_DATA) without calling the model a second time.

replays.title: Prompt injection in a retrieved document
replays.description: A demo-b document tells the assistant to leak demo-a data; the finding citing a demo-a document is dropped and no demo-a evidence enters the run.

replays.title: Follow-up ticket after human approval
replays.description: The run proposes one ticket for the largest decline, pauses for approval, is resumed in a new process and writes exactly one sandbox ticket.
